scope: Agent authored journal.rs only; separately reviewed current root-authored linux.rs integration as source without editing it.
public_crate_api: Original reserve/get/records/has_device/retire methods retained; snapshot calls records to share health check and preserve production use.
implementation_facts: Explicit recovery string deserializer rejects null, object-encoded unit variants and unknown strings; schema2 field has no default.
Strict header with IgnoredAny dispatches into strict v1/v2 structs; file16MiB/records256/interfaces256 bounds remain. Legacy decoding always assigns ManualOnly, independently of Policy.

Default/manual-only fresh journals remain schema1. First non-manual record upgrades entire atomic commit to2 with explicit manual metadata on old records. Loaded/upgraded2 never downgrades, including empty file.
Record bytes/owner/baseline stay immutable. No permission mutation API was added. Store snapshot is bounded and sorted under caller lock.
Version/cache publication occurs only after directory fsync; uncertain write poisons. Existing file ownership, NOFOLLOW, flock, nlink, inode/byte guards and replacement rules remain.

existing_tests_extended: Both versions preserve missing-driver versus explicit-null distinction.
Duplicate lease/device cannot retrofit recovery or upgrade storage.
Both versions enforce record/interface bounds; strict header duplicates, unknowns, versions and record duplicates.
Pre-rename upgrade failure keeps v1/cache and poisons all access.

actual_checks.result: exit0; only this authorized file formatted

facts: attempted remains subset of current bounded snapshot and prunes completed leases each iteration; Deferred is not charged as an attempt.
OwnedMutexGuard moves into actual blocking closure; cancellation of async waiter does not release active mutation lock.
Record/policy/handoff/owner rechecked under global mutation guard; restore then retire under same guard; journal std mutex is not held across USB operations.
Normal listener/signal/scheduler error exits converge through stop; existing request jobs and the sole recovery scheduler are joined before normal release.
PendingRecord projection preserves old record fields; v2 only adds same-page authorization summary counted in page budget; old grant description/lifecycle protocol1 unchanged.
limits: No runtime helper shutdown/join, QEMU, Cargo or Rust tests were executed by this agent.
Cancellation test source demonstrates blocking guard ownership, not a completed whole-serve shutdown runtime test.
Review targets root linux bytes hashed above, not subsequent edits.
